newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas says closer on domestic review.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas says closer on domestic review.

text.p: British Gas Plc said on Thursday it is "much closer" to regulator Ofgas on a review of its domestic price controls than on a parallel review of its Transco transmission operations.

Chairman Richard Giordano told Reuters he expects the domestic price review to be settled by "the end of September or mid-October," adding "my guess is that we are closer to Ofgas and Ofgas is closer to us on that review."
Giordano said British Gas is now in intense disussions with Ofgas over the Transco review, which the company has threatened to reject.
